name: TFDi Design MD-11

flaps._comment: MD-11 Dial-a-Flap system: continuous range 0-50 degrees. Key positions and speed values are provisional MD-11-family compatibility values pending redistributable public-source or vendor verification. Fractions are proportional to 50 degree max (0=0.00, 5=0.10, 15=0.30, 25=0.50, 35=0.70, 50=1.00). TFDi Quick Start confirms: takeoff 15 or 25, cleanup at 15, landing 35 (normal) or 50 (short/wet).

engines._comment: 3 engines: 2 underwing (GE CF6-80C2D1F or PW4460/4462) + 1 centre-mounted tail-cone engine. TFDi models both engine variants. EPR-based thrust management.

aircraftCfg._comment: An MD11 designator is accepted only when both the aircraft title and creator identify TFDi; bare MD11 metadata may identify traffic models or other MD-11 products.

lights._comment: Names are from TFDi's official MD-11 Integration Guide; only documented overhead switch and readback variables are used.

controls._comment: The dedicated page is monitoring-only. TFDi documents an event-driven CEVENT contract and warns against direct state/control LVAR writes, so only Flight Fabric's narrow standard gear/flaps surface fallback remains available.

meta.notes: Dedicated monitoring-first profile for the TFDi Design MD-11 passenger and freighter packages on MSFS 2020 and MSFS 2024. TFDi Design is the matching vendor; McDonnell Douglas is the aircraft manufacturer and Boeing is the product licensor. The page uses TFDi's published AFS, AP, APU, unit-mode, and V-speed integration variables plus a conservative standard-SimVar read allowlist. TFDi's documented -999/-9999 dashed-window sentinels are rendered as unavailable, and aircraft-specific writes remain disabled because TFDi's event-driven guide warns against direct state/control LVAR writes. Exact runtime identity and readbacks remain pending in-sim verification.

sources.name: TFDi MD-11 Integration Guide Variables
sources.notes: Documents the read-only MD11_AFS_* windows and dashed sentinels, MD11_AP_STATE enum, MD11_ATS_STATE raw state, MD11_ATS_CLAMP, MD11_APU_* state/readouts, MD11_AP_IAS_MACH, MD11_AP_HDG_TRK, MD11_AP_VS_FPA, MD11_AP_FT_M, MD11_V*, plus the MD11_OVHD_LTS_* names retained by the legacy telemetry layer.

sources.name: TFDi MD-11 Integration Guide
sources.notes: States that the aircraft is primarily event-driven and warns that direct variable writes bypass integrity checks; this is why the trusted adapter has no aircraft-specific write actions.

sources.name: TFDi Design MD-11 product page
sources.notes: Confirms the canonical TFDi Design MD-11 name, MSFS 2020/2024 support, passenger and freighter packages, and Boeing licensing.

sources.name: TFDi MD-11 navigation-data troubleshooting
sources.notes: Publishes the main package folder identifier tfdidesign-aircraft-md11 used by the exact config-path matcher.

sources.name: TFDi MD-11 FS24 livery catalog
sources.notes: Official catalog separates GE/PW passenger/freighter variants; an official catalog archive uses the SimObject family folder TFDi_Design_MD-11.

knownIssues: The TFDi integration-variable names and enums are vendor-published; the exact live SimConnect title and runtime readbacks remain unverified in-sim.

Standard SimVar lights, three-engine, gear, flap, fuel, and pressurization fields fail closed if a TFDi build does not mirror them; the centre-body landing gear has no separately verified binding on this page.
Flap and gear operating limits remain provisional MD-11-family compatibility values until cross-checked against redistributable public-source or vendor data for the target add-on configuration.

_comment: TFDi Design MD-11 for MSFS 2020 and 2024. Payware wide-body tri-jet (Boeing Officially Licensed) with GE CF6-80C2D1F or PW4460/4462 passenger/freighter variants. The exact-profile page is monitoring-only and uses TFDi-published integration variables without promoting state/control LVARs into writes. Flap and gear speed values remain provisional pending redistributable public-source or vendor verification.
